title: デビュー戦の後に・仕掛ける

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky successfully makes her debut. As for everyone's impressions of her, however…

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: She's a pretty interesting runner, but… I can't really tell if she's any good.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Probably a better idea to focus on the other racers. Now they're going places!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Betcha it's Spe and Grass hopping around in everyone's mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite it raining on her debut day, Special Week ran spectacularly, making her a hot topic among her peers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then there's the "Beast's Successor," Grass Wonder, seen as the strongest of the juniors. And that's not to mention the many other formidable newcomers.
choice_data_list: Guess there's no competing with the attention they're getting.
Guess there's no competing with the attention they're getting.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure… if attention's what you want. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Of course, this is great. It's exactly what I asked for!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: They can all keep up the hard work, so I can stay hidden away in the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That way, I can safely bide my time, secretly gathering strength. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Don't cause a fuss, don't make a sound… That's how you reel in the biggest catch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a gleam in her eyes. She must be planning to spend her junior year observing from afar while sharpening her skills in the meantime. In that case…
choice_data_list: Let's gradually build your experience by choosing races you're likely to win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nah, that's short-term thinking. See, there's an alternative option. It's called "taking it easy."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Figures… Why's "not racing" never the answer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm not sure about any easy-to-win races. Sure, it sounds simple, but is it really?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Maybe if I got a reward after each win, I'd have the right motivation… Who knows, right?
choice_data_list: …I'll add some nap time to your schedule.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm in!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, she agrees to a measured racing approach until the start of her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, on the way back to campus…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzt!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, a phone call. Give me a sec.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hello?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whoa, quiet down. Yeah, okay… All right, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …Right. Yep, I got it. Okay! Yeah. Yep. Byeee.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That was a surprise. He always calls me outta the blue.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Gramps. He was calling to congratulate me on my debut.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: He was going overboard with the excitement. I mean, this was just my debut.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Like, c'mon, Gramps, it's not that big of a deal…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may say that, but I can tell she's happy to have gotten the call.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, I am his adorable little granddaughter. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I know he loves me and all, but there's another reason he was so happy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahem, that is confidential information. If you must know, you'll need to fill out and submit a request form.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She still doesn't want to tell me everything, but I feel like I got a glimpse of a side of her she seldom shows.
